'''Kotohira Shrine''' (金刀比羅神社) is a {{ill|Shinto|abstract|Q812767|af|Sjintoïsme|an|Xintoísmo|anp|शिन्तो धर्म|ar|شنتو|ary|شينطو|arz|شنتو|as|শ্বিণ্ট'|ast|Sintoísmu|az|Şintoizm|azb|شینتوئیسم|ba|Синтоизм|bat_smg|Šintoėzmos|bcl|Shinto|be|Сінтаізм|be_x_old|Сінтаізм|bg|Шинтоизъм|blk|ဆိဉ်တိုဘာႏသာႏ|bn|শিন্তৌ ধর্ম|bo|ཧྲིན་ཐོ།|br|Shintoegezh|bs|Šintoizam|bxr|Синто|ca|Xintoisme|ckb|شینتۆ|cs|Šintoismus|cy|Shintō|da|Shinto|de|Shintō|diq|Şinto|el|Σιντοϊσμός|eo|Ŝintoo|es|Sintoísmo|et|Šintoism|eu|Sintoismo|ext|Sintoísmu|fa|شینتو|fi|Šintolaisuus|fiu_vro|Sinto|fr|Shintoïsme|fur|Sintoisim|fy|Sjintoïsme|gcr|Shintoyism|gd|Shinto|gl|Xintoísmo|gn|Sinto|got|𐍃𐌹𐌽𐍄𐍉|gu|શિન્તો|ha|Shinto|he|שינטו|hi|शिन्तो धर्म|hif|Shinto|hr|Šintoizam|hu|Sintó|hy|Սինտոիզմ|ia|Shinto|id|Shinto|io|Shinto|is|Sjintóismi|it|Shintoismo|ja|神道|jam|Shinto|jv|Shinto|ka|შინტოიზმი|kbp|Sinto|kg|Kisinto|kk|Синтоизм|km|ស៊ិនតូ|kn|ಶಿಂಟೋ ಧರ್ಮ|ko|신토|ks|شِنتو|ky|Шинто|la|Sintoismus|lad|Shintoizmo|lb|Shintō|lfn|Xinto|lij|Scintoiximo|lt|Šintoizmas|lv|Sintoisms|map_bms|Shinto|mg|Sintôisma|min|Shinto|mk|Шинтоизам|ml|ഷിന്റൊ|mn|Шинто|mni|ꯁꯤꯟꯇꯣ ꯂꯥꯢꯅꯤꯡ|mr|शिंतो धर्म|ms|Shinto|mt|Xintù|mwl|Xintoísmo|my|ရှင်တိုဘာသာ|nds|Shintō|new|शिन्तो धर्म|nl|Shintoïsme|nn|Shinto|no|Shintōisme|oc|Sintoïsme|olo|Šintolaižus|or|କାମିନୋ ମିଚି|pa|ਸ਼ਿੰਤੋਵਾਦ|pl|Shintō|pms|Shintoism|pnb|شنتو|ps|شينتو|pt|Xintoísmo|ro|Șintoism|ru|Синтоизм|rue|Сінтоїзм|sc|Shintoismu|scn|Shintuismu|sco|Shinto|sd|شنٽو|sh|Šintoizam|simple|Shinto|sk|Šintoizmus|sl|Šintoizem|sn|Ushintho|so|Shiintismi|sq|Shinto|sr|Шинтоизам|sv|Shinto|sw|Shinto|ta|சிந்தோ|te|షింటో మతం|tg|Шинто|th|ชินโต|tl|Shinto|tly|Sintoizm|tok|nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto|tt|Щинто|tyv|Синтоизм|uk|Синто|ur|شنتو|uz|Sintoizm|vi|Thần đạo|war|Shinto|wuu|神道|xmf|სინტოიზმი|yi|שינטא|yo|Shinto|za|Saenzdaugyau|zgh|ⵜⴰⵛⵉⵏⵟⵓⵜ|zh|神道|zh_min_nan|Sîn-tō|zh_yue|神道|qid=Q812767|lt=Shinto}} shrine located in {{ill|Naruto, Tokushima|en|Naruto, Tokushima|qid=Q460812|lt=Naruto}}, Tokushima Prefecture.

== History ==

The shrine was established in {{ill|1601|ab|1601|af|1601|als|1601|am|1601 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1601|ar|1601|ary|1601|arz|1601|ast|1601|avk|1601|az|1601|azb|۱۶۰۱ (میلادی)|ban|1601|bar|1601|bcl|1601|be|1601|be_x_old|1601|bg|1601|bn|১৬০১|bpy|মারি ১৬০১|br|1601|bs|1601.|ca|1601|cdo|1601 nièng|ceb|1601|ckb|١٦٠١|crh|1601|cs|1601|csb|1601|cv|1601|cy|1601|da|1601|de|1601|diq|1601|el|1601|eml|1601|eo|1601|es|1601|et|1601|eu|1601|fa|۱۶۰۱ (میلادی)|fi|1601|fo|1601|fr|1601|frr|1601|fur|1601|fy|1601|ga|1601|gan|1601年|gcr|1601|gd|1601|gl|1601|gv|1601|he|1601|hi|१६०१|hr|1601.|ht|1601 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1601|hy|1601|hyw|1601 թուական|ia|1601|id|1601|ilo|1601|io|1601|is|1601|it|1601|ja|1601年|jv|1601|ka|1601|kaa|1601|kk|1601 жыл|kn|೧೬೦೧|ko|1601년|krc|1601 джыл|la|1601|lb|1601|lez|1601 йис|li|1601|lij|1601|lmo|1601|lt|1601 m.|lv|1601. gads|mai|१६०१|map_bms|1601|mdf|1601|mg|1601|mhr|1601|mi|1601|mk|1601|mr|इ.स. १६०१|mrj|1601 и|ms|1601|my|၁၆၀၁|myv|1601 ие|mzn|۱۶۰۱|nah|1601|nap|1601|nds|1601|new|सन् १६०१|nl|1601|nn|1601|no|1601|nrm|1601|nso|1601|oc|1601|olo|1601|or|୧୬୦୧|os|1601-æм аз|pl|1601|pnb|1601|pt|1601|qu|1601|ro|1601|ru|1601 год|rue|1601|sa|१६०१|sah|1601|scn|1601|sd|1601ع|se|1601|sh|1601.|shn|1601|simple|1601|sk|1601|sl|1601|smn|1601|sq|1601|sr|1601|su|1601|sv|1601|sw|1601|szl|1601|ta|1601|te|1601|tg|Соли 1601|th|พ.ศ. 2144|tk|1601|tl|1601|tly|1601|tr|1601|tt|1601 ел|uk|1601|ur|1601ء|uz|1601|vec|1601|vi|1601|vls|1601|wa|1601|war|1601|wuu|1601年|xmf|1601|yi|1601|zh|1601年|zh_min_nan|1601 nî|zh_yue|1601年|qid=Q6725|lt=1601}} (Keichō 6) by Yaeemon Masuda, the lord of {{ill|Q11498684|ja|撫養城|qid=Q11498684}} (Hayasaki Castle). It enshrines a {{ill|Bunrei|en|Bunrei|qid=Q195793|lt=bunrei}} (spiritual branch) of the Zōzuzan Konpira Daigongen (now {{ill|Kotohira-gū|en|Kotohira-gū|qid=Q94760|lt=Kotohira-gū}}) from {{ill|Sanuki Province|en|Sanuki Province|qid=Q929682|lt=Sanuki Province}}. In {{ill|1640|ab|1640|af|1640|als|1640|am|1640 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1640|ar|1640|ary|1640|arz|1640|ast|1640|avk|1640|az|1640|azb|۱۶۴۰ (میلادی)|ban|1640|bar|1640|bcl|1640|be|1640|be_x_old|1640|bg|1640|bn|১৬৪০|bpy|মারি ১৬৪০|br|1640|bs|1640.|ca|1640|cdo|1640 nièng|ce|1640 шо|ceb|1640|ckb|١٦٤٠|crh|1640|cs|1640|cv|1640|cy|1640|da|1640|de|1640|diq|1640|el|1640|eml|1640|eo|1640|es|1640|et|1640|eu|1640|fa|۱۶۴۰ (میلادی)|fi|1640|fo|1640|fr|1640|frr|1640|fur|1640|fy|1640|ga|1640|gan|1640年|gcr|1640|gd|1640|gl|1640|gv|1640|he|1640|hi|१६४०|hif|1640|hr|1640.|ht|1640 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1640|hy|1640|hyw|1640 թուական|ia|1640|id|1640|ilo|1640|io|1640|is|1640|it|1640|ja|1640年|jv|1640|ka|1640|kaa|1640|kk|1640 жыл|kn|೧೬೪೦|ko|1640년|krc|1640 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1640|ku|1640|la|1640|lb|1640|lez|1640 йис|li|1640|lij|1640|lmo|1640|lt|1640 m.|lv|1640. gads|mai|१६४०|map_bms|1640|mdf|1640|mg|1640|mhr|1640|mi|1640|mk|1640|ml|1640|mn|1640 он|mr|इ.स. १६४०|mrj|1640 и|ms|1640|my|၁၆၄၀|myv|1640 ие|mzn|۱۶۴۰|nah|1640|nap|1640|nds|1640|new|सन् १६४०|nl|1640|nn|1640|no|1640|nrm|1640|nso|1640|olo|1640|or|୧୬୪୦|os|1640-æм аз|pa|1640|pl|1640|pnb|1640|pt|1640|qu|1640|ro|1640|ru|1640 год|rue|1640|sa|१६४०|sah|1640|scn|1640|sd|1640ع|se|1640|sh|1640.|shn|1640|si|1640|simple|1640|sk|1640|sl|1640|smn|1640|sq|1640|sr|1640|su|1640|sv|1640|sw|1640|szl|1640|ta|1640|tg|Соли 1640|th|พ.ศ. 2183|tk|1640|tl|1640|tly|1640|tr|1640|tt|1640 ел|uk|1640|ur|1640ء|uz|1640|vec|1640|vi|1640|vls|1640|wa|1640|war|1640|wuu|1640年|xmf|1640|yi|1640|zh|1640年|zh_min_nan|1640 nî|zh_yue|1640年|qid=Q6901|lt=1640}} (Kan'ei 17), the lord of {{ill|Tokushima Domain|es|Dominio de Tokushima|fa|قلمرو توکوشیما|fr|Domaine de Tokushima|ja|徳島藩|ko|도쿠시마번|ru|Токусима (княжество)|uk|Токушіма-хан|zh|德島藩|qid=Q3034557|lt=Tokushima Domain}}, {{ill|Hachisuka Tadateru|fr|Hachisuka Tadateru|ja|蜂須賀忠英|qid=Q3125469|lt=Hachisuka Tadahide}}, rebuilt the shrine's structures.

During the early Meiji era's {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|ca|Shinbutsu bunri|de|Shinbutsu-Bunri|es|Shinbutsu bunri|fa|شینبوتسو بونری|fi|Shinbutsu bunri|fr|Shinbutsu bunri|id|Shinbutsu bunri|it|Shinbutsu bunri|ja|神仏分離|ru|Симбуцу бунри|tr|Şinbutsu-bunri|zh|神佛分離|qid=Q1970535}}, the associated temple {{ill|Hase-dera|arz|هاس ديرا (ساكوراى, نارا, اليابان)|de|Hase-dera (Sakurai)|el|Ναός Χάσε-Ντέρα|fr|Hase-dera (Sakurai)|gan|長谷寺|ja|長谷寺|tr|Hase-dera|uz|Haze-dera|zh|長谷寺|qid=Q1457787|lt=Hasedera (Naruto City)}} was abolished, and shrine priests were appointed. In Meiji 3, the enshrined deity was identified as {{ill|Ōmononushi|ja|大物主命|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi-no-Mikoto|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmononushi no Mikoto|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmononushi|qid=Q10936701}} ([[Konpira Gongen]]), and the shrine's name changed from Konpira Daigongen to its current name. In {{ill|1874|ab|1874|af|1874|als|1874|am|1874 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1874|ar|1874|ary|1874|arz|1874|ast|1874|avk|1874|az|1874|azb|۱۸۷۴ (میلادی)|ba|1874 йыл|ban|1874|bar|1874|bat_smg|1874|bcl|1874|be|1874|be_x_old|1874|bg|1874|bn|১৮৭৪|bpy|মারি ১৮৭৪|br|1874|bs|1874.|ca|1874|cdo|1874 nièng|ce|1874 шо|ceb|1874|ckb|١٨٧٤|crh|1874|cs|1874|csb|1874|cv|1874|cy|1874|da|1874|de|1874|diq|1874|el|1874|eml|1874|eo|1874|es|1874|et|1874|eu|1874|fa|۱۸۷۴|fi|1874|fiu_vro|1874|fo|1874|fr|1874|frp|1874|frr|1874|fur|1874|fy|1874|ga|1874|gan|1874年|gcr|1874|gd|1874|gl|1874|gn|1874|gv|1874|hak|1874-ngièn|he|1874|hi|१८७४|hif|1874|hr|1874.|hsb|1874|ht|1874 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1874|hy|1874|hyw|1874 թուական|ia|1874|id|1874|ilo|1874|io|1874|is|1874|it|1874|ja|1874年|jv|1874|ka|1874|kaa|1874|kk|1874 жыл|kn|೧೮೭೪|ko|1874년|krc|1874 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1874|ku|1874|kv|1874-ӧд во|la|1874|lb|1874|lez|1874 йис|li|1874|lij|1874|lmo|1874|lt|1874 m.|lv|1874. gads|mai|१८७४|map_bms|1874|mdf|1874|mg|1874|mhr|1874|mi|1874|min|1874|mk|1874|mr|इ.स. १८७४|mrj|1874 и|ms|1874|my|၁၈၇၄|myv|1874 ие|mzn|۱۸۷۴|nah|1874|nap|1874|nds|1874|nds_nl|1874|new|ई सं १८७४|nl|1874|nn|1874|no|1874|nrm|1874|nso|1874|oc|1874|olo|1874|or|୧୮୭୪|os|1874-æм аз|pa|1874|pl|1874|pms|1874|pnb|1874|pt|1874|qu|1874|ro|1874|ru|1874 год|rue|1874|sa|१८७४|sah|1874|scn|1874|sd|1874ع|se|1874|sh|1874.|shn|1874|simple|1874|sk|1874|sl|1874|smn|1874|sq|1874|sr|1874|stq|1874|su|1874|sv|1874|sw|1874|szl|1874|ta|1874|tay|kawas na 1874|te|1874|tet|1874|tg|Соли 1874|th|พ.ศ. 2417|tk|1874|tl|1874|tly|1874|tr|1874|tt|1874 ел|udm|1874 ар|uk|1874|ur|1874ء|uz|1874|vec|1874|vi|1874|vls|1874|vo|1874|wa|1874|war|1874|wuu|1874年|xmf|1874|yi|1874|za|1874 nienz|zea|1874|zh|1874年|zh_classical|一八七四年|zh_min_nan|1874 nî|zh_yue|1874年|qid=Q7761|lt=1874}} (Meiji 7), it was designated as a Gōsha.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://awa-jinjacho.jp/shrine/detail.html?id=565|title=Kotohira Shrine|publisher=Tokushima Prefecture Shrine Association|accessdate=2021-03-25}}</ref>

Together with {{ill|Konpira Shrine (Tokushima)|ja|金刀比羅神社}} in Tokushima City's Seimi-chō and {{ill|Kotohira shrines|ja|金刀比羅神社|simple|Kotohira shrines|qid=Q11646488}} in Kawauchichō, these three shrines were historically known as "Awa San Konpira." Since the Meiji era, they have been referred to as "Awa San Kotohira."<ref>"History Walks of Tokushima Prefecture" (2009, Yamakawa Shuppansha, p. 105)</ref> The nearby {{ill|Konpiramae Station|ja|金比羅前駅|ko|곤피라마에역|zh|金比羅前站|qid=Q8190757|lt=Konpiramae Station}} on the {{ill|Naruto Line|de|Naruto-Linie|fr|Ligne Naruto|it|Linea Naruto|ja|鳴門線|ko|나루토선|zh|鳴門線|qid=Q861091|lt=Naruto Line}} is named after the shrine.

== Enshrined Deities ==
* {{ill|Ōmononushi|ja|大物主命|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi-no-Mikoto|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmononushi no Mikoto|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmononushi|qid=Q10936701}} ([[Konpira Gongen]])
* {{ill|Sukunabikona|ja|少彦名命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sukunabikona no Mikoto|13=User:Immanuelle/Sukunabikona|qid=Q3275687}}
* {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|ja|猿田彦命|lt=Sarutahiko no Mikoto}}

== Access ==
* By train: Approximately 1 minute on foot from {{ill|Konpiramae Station|ja|金比羅前駅|ko|곤피라마에역|zh|金比羅前站|qid=Q8190757|lt=Konpiramae Station}} on the {{ill|Naruto Line|de|Naruto-Linie|fr|Ligne Naruto|it|Linea Naruto|ja|鳴門線|ko|나루토선|zh|鳴門線|qid=Q861091|lt=JR Naruto Line}}.
* By car: Approximately 15 minutes from the {{ill|Naruto interchange|ja|鳴門インターチェンジ|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Naruto Interchange|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11173861}} on the {{ill|Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway|en|Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway|qid=Q11590177|lt=Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway}} or {{ill|Takamatsu Expressway|en|Takamatsu Expressway|qid=Q7677132|lt=Takamatsu Expressway}}.

In the early Meiji period ({{ill|Early Meiji|ja|明治初}}), following the {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|ca|Shinbutsu bunri|de|Shinbutsu-Bunri|es|Shinbutsu bunri|fa|شینبوتسو بونری|fi|Shinbutsu bunri|fr|Shinbutsu bunri|id|Shinbutsu bunri|it|Shinbutsu bunri|ja|神仏分離|ru|Симбуцу бунри|tr|Şinbutsu-bunri|zh|神佛分離|qid=Q1970535}}, the hereditary head temple, {{ill|Chokoku-ji Temple|ja|長谷寺 (鳴門市)|lt=Hase-dera|lt_ja=長谷寺|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hase-dera (Naruto City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11653684}}, was abolished and replaced with Shinto priests. In Meiji 3, the deity was designated as {{ill|Ōmononushi|en|Ōmononushi|qid=Q10936701|qid=Q10936701|lt=Ōmononushi}} and the former name of Kotobira Daigongen was changed to the current name. Together with the {{ill|Konpira Shrine (Tokushima)|ja|金刀比羅神社 (徳島市)|lt=Kotohira Shrine}} located in {{ill|Tokushima (city)|an|Tokushima|ar|توكوشيما (مدينة)|arz|توكوشيما|az|Tokuşima|azb|توکوشیما (شهر)|ban|Tokushima, Tokushima|be|Такусіма (горад)|bg|Токушима|ca|Tokushima|ce|Токусима (гӀала)|ceb|Tokushima Shi|cs|Tokušima|da|Tokushima|de|Tokushima|eo|Tokuŝimo|es|Tokushima (Tokushima)|et|Tokushima|eu|Tokushima|fa|توکوشیما (شهر)|fi|Tokushima|fr|Tokushima|gl|Tokushima|hak|Tokushima-sṳ|he|טוקושימה|hu|Tokusima|hy|Տոկուսիմա|id|Tokushima|it|Tokushima|ja|徳島市|ko|도쿠시마시|lt|Tokušima|mn|Токүшима|ms|Tokushima, Tokushima|mzn|توکوشیما (شهر)|nl|Tokushima (stad)|no|Tokushima (Tokushima)|pl|Tokushima|pt|Tokushima (cidade)|qu|Tokushima|ro|Tokushima|ru|Токусима (город)|sc|Tokushima|sco|Tokushima, Tokushima|sh|Tokushima|simple|Tokushima (city)|sr|Токушима|sv|Tokushima|sw|Tokushima, Tokushima|szl|Tokushima|tg|Токушима|th|โทกูชิมะ (เมือง)|tl|Lungsod ng Tokushima|tr|Tokushima|tt|Токусима (шәһәр)|uk|Токушіма|ur|توکوشیما|vi|Tokushima (thành phố)|war|Tokushima (syudad)|wuu|德岛市|zh|德島市|zh_classical|德島市|zh_min_nan|Tokusima-chhī|zh_yue|德島市|qid=Q207309|lt=Tokushima City}} {{ill|Seimicho|ja|勢見町|qid=Q11400568}} and the {{ill|Kotohira Shrine (Tokushima City Kawachi Town)|ja|金刀比羅神社 (徳島市川内町)|lt=Kotohira Shrine}} in {{ill|Kawauchichō|ja|川内町 (徳島市)|lt=Kawachi Town|lt_ja=川内町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kawachi Town (Tokushima City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11477745}}, it has long been known as "Awa San-Kotobira", and since the Meiji period it has been called "Awa San-Kotohira".<ref>"徳島県の歴史散歩" ({{ill|2009|en|2009|qid=Q1996|lt=2009}}, {{ill|Yamakawa Shuppansha|ja|山川出版社}}, p105)</ref>
Also, the name of {{ill|Konpiramae Station|ja|金比羅前駅|ko|곤피라마에역|zh|金比羅前站|qid=Q8190757|lt=Kotohira-mae Station}} on the {{ill|Naruto Line|de|Naruto-Linie|fr|Ligne Naruto|it|Linea Naruto|ja|鳴門線|ko|나루토선|zh|鳴門線|qid=Q861091|lt=Naruto Line}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|en|Shikoku Railway Company|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}} is derived from it.

==Transportation==
* Approximately a 1-minute walk from {{ill|Konpiramae Station|ja|金比羅前駅|ko|곤피라마에역|zh|金比羅前站|qid=Q8190757|lt=Kotohira-mae Station}} on the {{ill|Naruto Line|de|Naruto-Linie|fr|Ligne Naruto|it|Linea Naruto|ja|鳴門線|ko|나루토선|zh|鳴門線|qid=Q861091|lt=Naruto Line}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|en|Shikoku Railway Company|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}.
* Approximately a 15-minute drive from the {{ill|Naruto interchange|ja|鳴門インターチェンジ|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Naruto Interchange|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11173861}} of the {{ill|Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway|en|Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway|qid=Q11590177|lt=Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway}} and the {{ill|Takamatsu Expressway|en|Takamatsu Expressway|qid=Q7677132|lt=Takamatsu Expressway}}.
